Final for Publication

17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans ~ 4522 N. Kenton Ave., Chicago, IL
Proposed Zoning: RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District

Lot Area: 6,517 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant proposing to lawfully establish the rehab work of the existing
single-family residence. The existing single-family residence with a two-
car garage will remain. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional
Administrative Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-
L of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking an
Administrative Adjustment to increase the height of the existing single-
family residence by 10% or 30 ft.-7 inches.

(A) The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 2,284 square feet (0.35 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 6,517 square feet per D.U.
(1 residential units proposed)

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 2 parking spaces (for each single-family residence)

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 17.19 feet (existing)
b. Side Setbacks:
East Side: 7.35 feet (existing)
West Side: 13.26 feet (existing)
c. Rear Setback: 59.9 feet (existing)

()  *Building Height: 30 feet-7 inches
*Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-L, the Applicant is seeking an Administrative
Adjustment to increase the height of the existing single-family residence by 10%
or 30 feet-7 inches.
